sam: Quick heads-up 1: spun up omega13b-int8 candidate on staging. Good token savings but some multi-step completeness regressions in synthesis slices. Need a short scorecard for GTN/PM.

lee: smoke numbers?

sam: smoke: fp16 cost_per_token=$0.011, p95=150ms, accept=0.82; int8 cost_per_token=$0.0034, p95=168ms, accept=0.71; long_recall (6k) = -9.6pp, short (256) = -1.4pp; kv-cache ~80%.

gita: 3.2x token savings. Where are failures concentrated? omissions/step-skips?

sam: Mostly omitted bullets/enumerations. Prompt boost recovers ~2pp. Hybrid (attn fp16) recovers ~5pp at ~+18% cost vs int8.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary omega13b-int8 started (us-west). eval: https://internal/evals/omega13b/300

lee: Quick econ calc avg_tokens=800 -> savings_per_req=(0.011-0.0034)*800=$5.28. Include LTV sensitivity for GTN.

gita: Rollout rec: mixed fleet. Default hybrid for mid/long outputs, int8 for drafts, fp16 pinned for final exports. Gates: require long_recall >= -7pp and accept_drop <=3pp on 24h rolling window. Auto-rollback if accept_drop>4pp over 12h.

sam: I'm assembling the one-pager scorecard (variant, cost_per_token, p95_latency, long_recall_pp, short_recall_pp, accept_delta_pp, recommended_route, rollout_gates). Will attach eval CSV to INF-5200.

lee: Note: 300-sample noisy; recommend 2k A/B before large traffic shift. I'll prepare routing flags and cost sims.

gita: LGTM :thumbsup: will loop in GTN and PM with the short brief.

(small note: use labeled slices and priming-sensitivity metric in follow-up)
